Please note: this product is Shed and Fence Stain, not paint.

Fortress 9Ltr Dark Green Shed & Fence Stain offers a water-based solution for protecting and colouring exterior timber. This quick-drying formulation is showerproof in just one hour and fully dry within four hours, ensuring efficiency on the job. It provides reliable moisture protection and a rich dark green finish to garden wood, making it ideal for treating sheds, fences, and rough sawn panels. With an impressive coverage of up to 9m²/Ltr and a low odour, this stain helps to preserve and enhance outdoor wooden surfaces effectively and easily.
